summary: Gold Fork cabin: a 1918-20 rock-ledge platform, a 1933 L-4 cabin, moved in 1988 to the Crawford Work Center near Cascade, Idaho; sources disagree on the destination and elevation.

facts.agency: US Forest Service - Boise National Forest

New L-4 cabin on a 10 ft 20x20 concrete base, built 2 miles from the original location

Cabin moved to the Crawford Forest Work Center northeast of Cascade per the register; firelookout.com says two miles east of Cascade for private use; Forest Lookouts says the Crawford Ranger Station

corrections.current: None relocated (Moved from Gold Fork to the Crawford Work Center.)
corrections.proposed: 1988: relocated to the Crawford Forest Work Center, northeast of Cascade; 1933 L-4 cabin built about two miles from the original site
corrections.why: The register, Idaho Fire Lookouts and Forest Lookouts each record a 1988 move, so the 'None relocated' note is wrong.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the 2012 photo caption put the cabin at the Crawford Forest Work Center northeast of Cascade. Firelookout.com says two miles east of Cascade for private use, and Forest Lookouts says the Crawford Ranger Station. The story keeps the work center and reports the disagreement.
The register lists 4,889 ft (1,490 m), which matches the brief's elevation_m. Firelookout.com and Idaho Fire Lookouts list 7,790 ft. The sources do not explain the gap, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Four pages plus the firelookout.org list agree on the 1918-20 platform, the 1933 cabin and the 1988 move, but disagree on the 1988 destination and on elevation. Both are reported in the story. The brief's 'None relocated' event is wrong and is corrected. A firelookout.org listing also has a separate 'Gold Fork Valley' entry at 44.67137, -115.83580 marked Ground Gone; it is not clearly the 1918-20 site, so it is not used. Staffing is documented only by two 1935 and 1945 newspaper items quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, and the originals were not read. Access is left unknown; only the 'Drive-Up' label is recorded. No notable fires were found. Height is not recorded.
